About Mylon

From Barbados to Kigali — a self-built career spanning four decades

Mylon Oderson WASON is a Barbadian-born entrepreneur, international business development strategist, enterprise architect, and institutional leader with more than four decades of experience across insurance, financial services, real estate, technology, and international commerce.

"I became everything I needed to become because someone else needed my help in that area."

His professional journey is distinguished by an unconventional path. Beyond his foundational insurance sales training at Barbados Life Insurance, Wason had no formal entrepreneurial training, no prior business knowledge, and no mentor to guide him. Everything that followed was self-taught — driven by necessity, practical experience, and an enduring commitment to serving others.

Career Journey

Four decades of self-directed enterprise

No formal training. No prior blueprint. A career built entirely through necessity, observation, and an unwavering commitment to solving the problems of others.

Early 1980s
Insurance Sales Foundation
Barbados Life Insurance provided his first professional training — salesmanship, customer relationships, financial responsibility, and the foundations of professional discipline. Everything else was built on this.
1988
Oderson Incorporated — Established
His first corporate milestone — establishing Oderson Incorporated in Barbados. The foundation for four decades of enterprise development across real estate, financial services, telecommunications, and international commerce.
Ongoing
Multi-Sector Enterprise Development
Real estate · Insurance · Investment banking · Telecommunications retail · Merchant services · Network marketing · International commerce. Each sector added new competencies, new insights into capital, markets, and institutional development.
Present
ODIECLOUD²π — Digitizing Global Africa
The culmination: a Governed Economic Operating System (GeOS) designed to connect people, businesses, institutions, investors, and capital across Africa, the Caribbean, and the global African diaspora.
Philosophy & Governance

ENGINEERING ENTERPRISES™

For Wason, an enterprise is more than a registered company. It requires coordinated governance, qualified people, technology, capital, operational procedures, market access, and accountable leadership — systematically designed and integrated.

Personal Disciplines

Lifelong commitment to physical discipline and continuous learning

The same principles that built an entrepreneurial career — discipline, perseverance, adaptability, and a willingness to teach — run through four decades of martial arts practice and instruction.

🥋

Karate — 40+ Years

More than four decades of training and teaching karate. Holds the rank of Sixth-Degree Black Belt (6th Dan). His extensive experience as both practitioner and instructor reflects a lifelong commitment to technical mastery, self-control, and the passing of knowledge to others.

🎾

Squash — Since Age 15

Playing squash since the age of 15 — a sport that demands physical endurance, speed, precision, strategic thinking, and rapid decision-making. A lifelong sporting commitment that has remained an active part of his personal discipline for decades.

🏓

Pickleball — 3 Years

Over the past three years, Wason has added pickleball to his sporting activities. His adoption of the sport reflects a characteristic willingness to embrace new challenges, develop new skills, and continue learning throughout life — at every stage of experience.
